Rhubarb Drink
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 9:23am

Ingredients




1 cup rhubarb, cut up
1 cup water
cup sugar
1 (6 oz.) can frozen pink lemonade

Preparation

1 Cook all ingredients. Strain. Chill. Just before serving add 16 oz lemon-lime soda. Need to triple recipe for large crowd. 2 Strained rhubarb can be used cup for cup like applesauce in a cake or cookie recipe.
